prompts.dailyDescription: Write and save the daily report from the activity logs
prompts.weeklyDescription: Write and save the weekly report from the daily reports
prompts.monthlyDescription: Write and save the monthly report from the daily reports
prompts.logSessionDescription: Record what was done in this conversation
prompts.daily: Write my daily report{{date}} with Remem. Call prepare_report, write the report by following the returned template and target language, show it to me, and then store it with save_summary.
prompts.weekly: Write my weekly report{{date}} with Remem. Call prepare_period_report with period "weekly", write the report by following the returned template and target language, show it to me, and then store it with save_period_summary.
prompts.monthly: Write my monthly report{{date}} with Remem. Call prepare_period_report with period "monthly", write the report by following the returned template and target language, show it to me, and then store it with save_period_summary.
prompts.logSession: Record what we did in this conversation with Remem. Call list_tags to see existing project and tag names, then call log once for each finished piece of work, decision or note, with a suitable project and tags. Finally list what you recorded.
prompts.startDayDescription: Show what was planned for today and what was done last
prompts.startDay: Let's start the day with Remem. Call get_briefing and show me what I planned to do today. Then call get_report for the most recent working day and summarize in a few lines what I did, so I can pick up where I left off.
